summary: Official sources accessed 2026-10-07. One application covers the consolidated Databricks and Neon program. Benefits include conditional credits, hands-on technical guidance and go-to-market support. Enrollment deadline, credit-use expiry, payment-card conditions and existing-paid-customer exclusions are not stated in the loaded program pages. General Databricks documentation confirms account signup is necessary for users without an account; this does not establish the startup application itself requires a login.
claim_steps: Apply to the Databricks Startup Program from its official program page.
Databricks reviews the application and gets back to the applicant.

social_proof.title: Databricks for startups
social_proof.text: Qualifying startups can receive up to $200K in credits for Databricks and Neon. Not sure if you qualify? Apply or ask your investor

social_proof.title: Announcing the new Databricks Startup Program
social_proof.text: This program is purpose-built for early-stage, venture-backed startups. We’re especially looking to support founders who have recently raised institutional funding (pre-seed through Series A) and are building their company on data and AI.

social_proof.title: Get started tutorials on Databricks | Databricks on AWS
social_proof.text: If you do not have a Databricks account, sign up for a free trial.

social_proof.author: Databricks
social_proof.text: We're launching a new Databricks Startup Program! Qualifying venture-backed startups can now receive up to $200K in credits across Databricks and @neondatabase, giving founders access to the app backend, data, and AI stack they need to go from idea to product-market fit.
